name: Caladbolg

attributes.attribute: carried by the hero Fergus mac Roich
blade whose Welsh name matches Caladbolg

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caladbolg is a famous sword of Irish myth. The warrior Fergus mac Roich carried it. Its name matches the Welsh name of the blade Excalibur. That links it to the sword of King Arthur. Rainbows appeared when Fergus swung it. Once he cut the tops off the mountains of the midlands. The flat hill crests of Ireland still show that blow.

okr.objective: A magical Irish sword linked to both a hero and a famous blade.
key_results: Caladbolg belonged to the warrior Fergus mac Roich.
Its name echoes the Welsh word for Excalibur.
Swung by Fergus it showed rainbows and cut the mountain tops.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2008.
